description: This file defines a singleton class 'VoiceSessionCoordinator' responsible for managing voice recognition sessions, including starting, updating, finalizing, sending, and dismissing voice sessions. It interacts with overlay UI components and forwarding mechanisms, and maintains session state.

classes.name: VoiceSessionCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class that orchestrates voice session management, such as initiating, updating, finalizing, and dismissing sessions, while coordinating UI overlays and forwarding voice transcripts.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new voice recognition session with specified source and text, possibly with attributed text and forwarding enabled, returning a session token.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the current session with partial transcription text and attributed text.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the session with complete text, sends a chime, and optionally sets an auto-send delay, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: sendNow
methods.description: Forces the immediate sending of the current transcript if non-empty, dismissing the overlay if empty.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the current session overlay with specified reason and outcome.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the voice input level indicator.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current session token, text, and overlay visibility state.

methods.name: overlayDidDismiss
methods.description: Handles cleanup when overlay is dismissed, also refreshes runtime state.
